Title: Tanay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Tanay - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Zoya - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Pallavi - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Karan - 42 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Pallavi stands near him.]

Tanay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Tanay lies down on the sofa.]

Tanay (happily): "This is amazing!"

[Tanay sits down on a chair.]

Tanay: "I knew it!"

[Tanay flops down on the sofa.]

Tanay (surprised): "I knew it!"

[Tanay sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Pallavi: "That's great!"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

[Tanay stands in the bedroom. Pallavi and Karan stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Karan, look over here."

[Tanay yawns loudly.]

Pallavi: "This is amazing!"

[Tanay stretches his arms above his head.]

Karan: "Okay, Tanay."

Scene 3: The park - Day

Karan: "Let's begin."

[Tanay catches the ball.]

Tanay: "Let's see."

[Tanay kicks the football hard.]

Tanay: "I knew it!"

[Tanay plays cricket in the park.]

Tanay (excited): "Oh wow!"

[Tanay swings on the swing.]

Zoya: "Mom, listen!"

[Tanay plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Pallavi: "One more time!"

[Tanay plays with his dog.]

Pallavi: "Yes, all right."

[Zoya skips rope.]

Zoya: "What a day to remember!"
